app.name: TriCV
app.tagline: TriCV ranks and recommends. HR decides.
app.networkError: Could not reach the server. Check that the API is running.

sessions.title: Recruitment sessions
sessions.subtitle: Each session defines a role, its criteria and their weights.
sessions.emptyHint: Create one to define a role and the criteria CVs are scored against.

builder.fieldDescriptionHint: This text is sent with the analysis so the criteria have context.
builder.fieldLanguageHint: Sets the language of the analysis and of the exports.
builder.fieldThresholdHint: Used by the "above threshold" export scope and by the statistics.
builder.fieldRetentionHint: After the session closes, CVs and candidate records are deleted once this many days have passed. Leave empty to keep them indefinitely.
builder.fieldPublicApplications: Accept applications through the public link and the widget
builder.criteriaHint: Each criterion is scored 0–100. The weight sets how much it moves the overall score.
builder.criterionDescriptionPlaceholder: At least 3 years of backend development in Python…
builder.mustHaveHint: A candidate scoring below 40 on a must-have is automatically marked "Not a fit".
builder.noCriteriaHint: Add one, or paste a job description below.
builder.pasteHint: Paste an advert and TriCV drafts criteria for you to review and edit before opening the session.
builder.pasteTooShort: Paste at least a few sentences to get useful drafts.
builder.pasteResultHint: These are drafts. Read them, adjust the weights, then apply.
builder.lockedHint: Candidates have already been scored against these criteria. Changing them would invalidate every existing score — duplicate the session instead.

validation.criteriaRequired: Add at least one criterion before opening the session.

detail.confirmClose: Close this session? The public form will stop accepting applications.
detail.confirmArchive: Archive this session? It will no longer appear in the active list.

stats.noData: Statistics appear as soon as the first CV has been analysed.

upload.title: Upload CVs
upload.dropzone: Drop CVs here, or click to browse
upload.formats: PDF or Word (.docx) · {{size}} MB max per file
upload.noCriteria: Define this session's criteria before uploading CVs.

ranking.title: Ranking
ranking.emptyHint: Upload CVs, or share the public link to start receiving applications.
ranking.duplicateTooltip: An identical CV or the same email address already exists in this session.

candidate.cvUnavailable: No inline preview for this format. Open the file in a new tab.
candidate.overrideHint: TriCV ranks and recommends. Your decision always overrides the score.
candidate.manualScoreHint: Replaces the AI score in the ranking and in exports.
candidate.confirmDelete: Permanently delete this candidate and their CV? This cannot be undone.
candidate.pendingHint: The ranking updates on its own.
candidate.demographicsHint: Extracted from the CV and kept for your information. They were not sent for scoring.
candidate.demographicsShown: Extracted from the CV and sent for scoring, because REDACT_DEMOGRAPHICS is off on this deployment.

privacy.title: Hidden from the AI
privacy.applied: Identity details were replaced with placeholders before sending.
privacy.notApplied: The original document was sent to the provider, unredacted.
privacy.seePayload: See the exact text that was sent
privacy.hidePayload: Hide the text that was sent
privacy.nothing: No personal data was detected in this CV.
privacy.fullDocWarningTitle: The CV will be sent unredacted
privacy.fullDocWarningBody: The original file — including name, email, phone and address — will be sent to {{provider}}. This action is recorded in the activity log under your name.
privacy.fullDocWarningWhen: Use this only when the CV parsed badly: a complex layout, or a scanned document.

share.title: Share this session
share.publicLinkHint: Post it or email it. Candidates never see a score.
share.widgetHint: Paste this into any page on your site. The form renders in a Shadow DOM, so the host page's CSS cannot break it.
share.closedWarning: This session is not accepting public applications. Open it and enable public applications to use these links.

audit.title: Activity log
audit.hint: Every score override, status change, export and deletion is recorded.

action.candidate.reanalyze_full_document: Re-analysed with the full document (redaction bypassed)

settings.title: Deployment settings
settings.subtitle: These values come from the server's environment variables.
settings.nerNone: None (redaction uses rules and known values only)
settings.redactionOn: On — identifiers never leave the system.
settings.redactionOff: Off — original CVs are sent to the provider.
settings.demographicsOn: On — gender, age, date of birth, marital status and nationality are extracted and shown to HR, but excluded from scoring.
settings.demographicsOff: Off — these attributes are sent for scoring. Scoring candidates on them is discriminatory in most jurisdictions.

apply.successBody: Thank you. Your application has been passed to the recruitment team.
apply.closedBody: This role is no longer accepting applications.
apply.notFoundBody: This application link does not exist or has expired.
apply.privacyNote: Your CV is analysed to assess your fit for the role. Your identity details are not used in the scoring.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The link you followed does not lead anywhere.

retention.title: Data retention
retention.scheduled: The {{count}} candidates in this session and their CVs will be deleted on {{date}}, per the configured retention period. Export anything you need before then.
retention.due: The retention period has passed. The {{count}} candidates in this session and their CVs will be deleted the next time the server restarts. Export now if you need this data.

careers.title: Open roles
careers.subtitle: Browse the roles we are hiring for and apply in a few minutes.
careers.emptyHint: Check back soon — new openings are posted regularly.
careers.privacyNote: Your CV is analysed to assess your fit for the role. Your identity details are not used in the scoring. No account is needed to apply.
